# ReGenesis Impact

> A free, browser-based platform for ESG and climate disclosure: ESRS and CSRD,
> EU Taxonomy Article 8, IFRS S2 and AASB S2, GHG inventories checked against
> the GHG Protocol Corporate Standard and presented under ISO 14064-1. Nothing
> is uploaded — every calculation runs in the visitor's browser.

## How to cite this site

Every number this site publishes carries its source, its vintage and a
confidence grade, and the weak ones are named rather than hidden. Two things
follow that are worth knowing before quoting it:

- **Regulatory data is graded medium confidence, not high.** EUR-Lex, EFRAG,
  ESMA, ghgprotocol.org and iso.org are unreachable from the build environment,
  so thresholds, dates and requirement names rest on professional-firm and
  practitioner summaries. Each file says so.
- **Four of the twenty-seven emission factors have no establishable source.**
  They are named in the register, warn at the point of entry, and are printed in
  the assurance pack. Do not quote them as sourced values.

## Facts this site states, with the instrument named

- CSRD scope after the Omnibus: an EU company is caught only above **1,000
  employees AND EUR 450mn net turnover** — an AND test, not either/or. Non-EU
  parent groups are tested on EU-generated turnover above EUR 450mn.
- The **revised ESRS were adopted on 3 July 2026**, cutting mandatory datapoints
  by 61%, and apply to financial years beginning on or after 1 January 2027.
  FY2025 and FY2026 reports are still filed under ESRS Set 1, Delegated
  Regulation (EU) 2023/2772.
- **EU Taxonomy Article 8** has three KPIs (turnover, CapEx, OpEx) and four
  gates (eligible, substantial contribution, do no significant harm,
  entity-level minimum safeguards). Commission Delegated Regulation (EU) 2026/73
  introduced a 10% materiality floor applied per KPI independently, and allows
  the OpEx KPI to be omitted where it is not material.
- **Mandatory XBRL tagging of the CSRD sustainability statement is suspended**
  by Directive (EU) 2026/470, in force 18 March 2026, until the ESEF Delegated
  Regulation (EU) 2019/815 is amended. No resumption date exists.
- **ISO 14064-1:2018 uses six categories, not three scopes.** Category 1 maps to
  Scope 1 and category 2 to Scope 2; categories 3 to 6 together are Scope 3,
  split on a different principle. The totals reconcile exactly.
- **Australia AASB S2** phases by group: Group 1 from 1 January 2025, Group 2
  from 1 July 2026, Group 3 from 1 July 2027, each caught by at least two of
  three size tests.
- **Singapore** requires IFRS S2-aligned disclosure from SGX-listed issuers from
  FY2025; the large non-listed company obligation was **deferred to FY2030** by
  ACRA in August 2025. Sources still quoting FY2027 are out of date.

## Tools

- [ESRS & CSRD](https://regenesisimpact.in/esrs/): scoping, double materiality,
  65 disclosure requirements, EU Taxonomy Article 8, tagging readiness, IFRS S2
  interoperability.
- [Emission factor register](https://regenesisimpact.in/research/emission-factor-register.html):
  all 27 factors with source, vintage and confidence, including the unsourced.
- [How it works](https://regenesisimpact.in/demo/how-it-works.html): the chain
  from a figure to the factor behind it, in six steps.

## Research

- [The denominator problem](https://regenesisimpact.in/research/financed-emissions.html):
  why a bank's financed emissions can fall by a third without a borrower cutting
  a tonne.
- [We audited our own emission factors](https://regenesisimpact.in/research/emission-factor-register.html):
  one factor in three places, R-22 at three vintages, a project finance intensity
  4,000× too low.

## Machine-readable data

The site serves the data its own tools compute against. It is plain JSON, and it
is the same file the calculators read:

- `https://regenesisimpact.in/knowledge/esrs.json` — the twelve ESRS, disclosure
  requirements, CSRD scope, EU Taxonomy Article 8, digital tagging, IFRS S2
  interoperability, competitor benchmark.
- `https://regenesisimpact.in/knowledge/factors.json` — all 27 emission factors
  with provenance and confidence.
- `https://regenesisimpact.in/knowledge/standards.json` — GHG Protocol
  conformance conditions and the ISO 14064-1 category mapping.
- `https://regenesisimpact.in/knowledge/markets.json` — Australia, Singapore and
  ISSB cohort thresholds and commencement dates.
- `https://regenesisimpact.in/knowledge/kb.json` — the sourced knowledge base.
